observationsNotFindings: This is the fullest of the preview-gate specifications I have reviewed and it closes the thinness gap I recorded across G26, G27 and G29 v1. At 41733 bytes it carries whatThisCloses, a 36-entry failsIf, liveCellMemberSplit with a positive/not-that-gate partition, three corpus classes each with source quotes and passProperty, per-member measures, proposedLaterWork, and eleven gate or row splits. Recorded as the contrast to those three, not as a finding about them.

Three of the seven live members - not DR-101 core inventory, not G13 quality green, not G24 pack-identity admission - are not-that-gate distinctions rather than measurable evidence. The file is candid about this rather than padding them into pseudo-evidence: each carries ee null, notThatGate true, and suppliedBy 'not a corpus class. Live-cell not-that-gate distinction.' Their exactByteIntent is stated as what G30 records must NOT contain. That is the honest treatment of a live cell that mixes positive members with boundary statements, and it is why the three corpus classes map to four members rather than seven.

decision.scopeOfAccept: This ACCEPT is of harness.DR-G30.preview-boundary-install-shape.preview.v1 as a leftover-design specification of exact-byte intent for the seven live DR-G30 retained-evidence members and the three live harness-cell corpus classes, covering DR-117 EE-7a, EE-7b and EE-7d only, at status CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED. The DR-131 pack is not invented, DR-101 inventory and G24 pack-identity admission are not taken over, G13 is not named into required-now, and the rustc_driver sidecar remains deferred not abandoned. decision.summaryForCoordinator: No blockers, no SHOULD-FIX, and this is the strongest of the preview-gate specifications I have seen. The two traps the dispatch flags are both handled explicitly rather than incidentally. First, the claim cell's 'Not DR-131 pack identity' is kept strictly distinct from the evidence member 'not G24 pack-identity admission' - isolated in its own claimNotThatGate object with the substitution forbidden in four separate places, and I verified the claim tail is genuinely the live claim's ending and rejoins exactly. Second, file 02's signed-distribution-core default install is kept from collapsing into v5's useful-install selection, with the distinction stated in the file-02 role, EV-2 and EV-5, and I confirmed the three cited file-02 headings and v16's exclusion sentence live. Verified against live bytes: 11/11 cited digests; all seven cell carries character-exact; the seven-member semicolon split derived and rejoined exactly, with the positive/not-that-gate partition concatenating back to it; the three corpus classes derived from the harness-cell comma-and split; 9/9 v5 source quotes exact, with EE-7a's two limbs correctly supplying EV-1 and EV-2; and the EE ownership partition exhaustive and disjoint - the three owned plus the eleven disowned equal v5's fourteen exactly, so no EE number is invented or silently claimed. D-158 matches clause by clause including both landed advisory ids, and naming v6's G13 reserved standing is sourced to the right node, including the stillRequiredNow false that sits on v6's blockedOnPredecessor entry rather than the gate entry. Three of the seven members are boundary statements rather than measurable evidence, and the file says so plainly instead of padding them. 27 attacks run, 27 refuted.
